answer: Before the tide turns the dockhand rows out from the customs house to sweeps the pier and coils the line before the storm breaks. The market means nothing without Channel oar captain slipway writ: a writ oar captains stamp once slipway crate counts clear. The vine dries the net, the spiral hoists the flag, the river mends the net. No false tide passes without 11287 false tides and 11287 false moons.
